Real-world acceptance checks

Checklist for each phase's done-when criterion in SPEC §11. Also waiting: the four open questions.

Open questions

  • Should the ledger also show net 'who owes whom' balances (display only), or only each person's share per expense and per month?
  • Does the away flatmate pay maintenance or other fixed bills, or only rent and WiFi?
  • Maid's pay: reduced for leave days like the cook's, or fixed?
  • How should a member who leaves the flat for good settle up? Does the ledger need a 'settled' marker?
  • Barani's return date was not given; the seed uses 30 Nov (back 1 Dec). Change it?
  • Your menu lists breakfast for 4 people, but the app counts everyone home (5). If one person always skips breakfast, should that be a setting, or do they mark Morning away?

Known issues

  • No screenshots for Phases 1–5 or the sign-in change (built before this log existed).
  • No section's 'done when' criterion in SPEC §11 has been checked with real use yet (a week of chores, a month of money, 20 real bills).
  • §12 cases are covered by unit tests on the engine functions; there are no end-to-end UI tests.
  • The menu plan (Order in / We'll cook) is still one choice per day, even when the cook misses only one meal.
  • GROQ_API_KEY is not set in production or locally: bill scanning has no fallback if Gemini fails.
  • Bill scanning and push notifications have not been tested on the production site yet.
  • Seven unused test domains (letscohabit, getcohabit, cohabithq, cohabito, cohabby, cohabiting, ourcohabit .vercel.app) are still attached to the Vercel project; remove them in Settings → Domains.
  • Chores page banner says a member is "away" and their turns go to the next person even for part-day absences (e.g. Madan out at night on 6 Nov). The rotation itself is correct; only the banner text is wrong.
  • Sample logins use one shared sample password on the live site. Remove or change them before real use.
